import hashlib
import importlib.metadata as metadata
import json
import os
from pathlib import Path
import platform
import subprocess
import sys
from datetime import datetime, timezone
import numpy as np
from PIL import Image
import donkeycar_hy.preprocess as preprocessing
from donkeycar_hy.udacity_dataset import UdacityDataset

root = Path.cwd()
out = root / "docs/experiments/udacity-stage-a"
data_root = Path(os.environ["HYTORCH_UDACITY_DATA"])
assert root in Path(preprocessing.__file__).resolve().parents
assert "torch" not in sys.modules and "hytorch" not in sys.modules
dataset = UdacityDataset(data_root)
split = dataset.split_temporal()
split.save_manifest(out / "split-indices.json")
environment = {
    "recorded_at_utc": datetime.now(timezone.utc).isoformat(),
    "python": sys.version,
    "executable": sys.executable,
    "platform": platform.platform(),
    "packages": {name: metadata.version(name) for name in ("numpy", "Pillow", "pytest")},
    "cwd": str(root),
    "branch": subprocess.check_output(["git", "branch", "--show-current"], text=True).strip(),
    "base_commit": subprocess.check_output(["git", "rev-parse", "HEAD"], text=True).strip(),
    "initial_shared_checkout_branch": "experiment/conv-backward-shape-dispatch",
    "initial_shared_checkout_head": "e2d60c26cdb28facd4a41dd3b443c3148e397b66",
    "dataset": str(dataset.data_dir),
    "CUDA_VISIBLE_DEVICES": os.environ.get("CUDA_VISIBLE_DEVICES"),
    "torch_imported_for_dataset": "torch" in sys.modules,
    "hytorch_imported_for_dataset": "hytorch" in sys.modules,
    "preprocess_source": preprocessing.__file__,
    "gpu_or_model_training_executed": False,
}
samples = []
for index in (0, len(dataset)//2, len(dataset)-1):
    x, t = dataset[index]
    record = dataset.records[index]
    with Image.open(record.image_path) as raw:
        raw_size, raw_mode = raw.size, raw.mode
    samples.append({
        "source_index": record.index, "csv_line": record.csv_line,
        "timestamp": record.timestamp.isoformat(), "filename": record.image_path.name,
        "raw_size_width_height": raw_size, "raw_mode": raw_mode,
        "image_shape": list(x.shape), "image_dtype": str(x.dtype),
        "c_contiguous": bool(x.flags.c_contiguous),
        "finite": bool(np.isfinite(x).all()), "image_min": float(x.min()), "image_max": float(x.max()),
        "label_shape": list(t.shape), "label_dtype": str(t.dtype), "steering": float(t[0]),
    })
from hytorch.dataloaders import DataLoader
import hytorch
assert root in Path(hytorch.__file__).resolve().parents
x, t = next(iter(DataLoader(dataset, batch_size=4, shuffle=False)))
summary = {
    "dataset": dataset.statistics(),
    "zero_count": int((dataset.label == 0).sum()),
    "valid_center_paths": sum(r.image_path.is_file() for r in dataset.records),
    "csv_sha256": hashlib.sha256(dataset.csv_path.read_bytes()).hexdigest(),
    "preprocess": {"color": "RGB", "crop_top": preprocessing.CROP_TOP, "crop_bottom": 0,
                   "resize_width_height": list(preprocessing.TARGET_SIZE),
                   "interpolation": "Pillow bilinear", "normalization": "x/127.5-1",
                   "output": "C-contiguous CHW numpy.float32"},
    "samples": samples,
    "batch": {"image_shape": list(x.shape), "label_shape": list(t.shape),
              "image_dtype": str(x.dtype), "label_dtype": str(t.dtype)},
    "splits": {name: getattr(split, name).statistics() for name in ("train", "validation", "excluded")},
    "split_source_index_ranges_inclusive": {name: [min(part.indices), max(part.indices)] if len(part) else []
                                          for name in ("train", "validation", "excluded")
                                          for part in (getattr(split, name),)},
    "gap_seconds_requested": split.gap_seconds,
    "actual_train_validation_gap_seconds":
        (split.validation_start - split.train.records[-1].timestamp).total_seconds(),
    "no_gap_split_counts": {name: len(getattr(dataset.split_temporal(gap_seconds=0), name))
                           for name in ("train", "validation", "excluded")},
    "hytorch_source": hytorch.__file__,
    "torch_imported_after_dataloader": "torch" in sys.modules,
}
for name, value in (("environment.json", environment), ("inspection.json", summary)):
    with (out/name).open("x", encoding="utf-8") as stream:
        json.dump(value, stream, indent=2, ensure_ascii=False, allow_nan=False)
        stream.write("\n")
print(json.dumps(summary, indent=2, ensure_ascii=False, allow_nan=False))
